name: Blake Hall
summary: Blake Hall (Blakehallhq@gmail.com) hired ALTR Services to restore the banned Instagram account @snowbunnyuniversity (612k followers) without filing an appeal. The account had been restored once before, about a month earlier, through another Meta rep named Skyler. Restoration took about 8 days. Blake got frustrated during the wait and almost switched to his original rep, but the account came back on 2026-10-04. Price was negotiated down to $4.5k and an invoice was sent through quote.altrservices.com, but it was still unpaid as of 2026-10-05. He is now asking for help getting his collabs feature back.
key_facts: Account: @snowbunnyuniversity on Instagram, 612k followers, banned without an appeal filed
Restored on 2026-10-04 ("#3 on the whole list"). Blake asked for about 5 days in total; the quoted turnaround was 1-5 days
Agreed price: $4,500, negotiated down. He said he had only $4.8k left after paying middleman fees to others
Invoice sent 2026-10-04: https://quote.altrservices.com/inv/2273766f-2d76-4bb3-8333-9476da6e1be4. Unpaid as of 2026-10-05; he says he'll pay when Derrek is ready
Expected flow: account restored, 30-minute cooldown, then payment (how his previous rep Skyler worked)
Has another Meta rep (his 'OG rep'), who also handles bans for OnlyFans clients of his friends
Promised to refer two more unbans; has a friend who needs an unban
Connected through Lopey, who was in the group chat
Based in LA; prefers Zelle or Apple Pay
Follow-up request: restore collabs on the account
Communication was rocky during the wait. He was anxious and said updates were lacking
